name: lookup_book
description:
Look up a book in the library catalog.

Parameters
----------
code : str
    ISBN-13 of the book, thirteen digits such as 9780306406157.

Returns
-------
dict
    The catalog record.

name: lookup_product
description:
Look up an item in the store inventory.

Parameters
----------
code : str
    Store SKU in the form AB-1234.

Returns
-------
dict
    The inventory record.

name: lookup_paper
description:
Look up a published research paper.

Parameters
----------
code : str
    DOI of the paper, starting with '10.', such as 10.1038/nphys1170.

Returns
-------
dict
    The paper's metadata.

name: cpu_stats
description:
Report processor load for a server.

Parameters
----------
host : str
    Hostname of the server.
window_minutes : int, optional
    Averaging window in minutes: 1, 5 or 15.

Returns
-------
float
    Load average over the window.

name: memory_stats
description:
Report RAM consumption for a server.

Parameters
----------
host : str
    Hostname of the server.
include_swap : bool, optional
    Also report swap / page-file usage.

Returns
-------
dict
    Used and free memory in MiB.

name: disk_stats
description:
Report storage use for a server.

Parameters
----------
host : str
    Hostname of the server.
mount : str, optional
    Mount point or drive to inspect, such as /var or C:.

Returns
-------
dict
    Used and free bytes on the mount.

name: send_email
description:
Deliver a written message to a person.

Parameters
----------
recipient : str
    Email address such as name@example.com.
text : str
    Message body.

Returns
-------
str
    Delivery id.

name: send_sms
description:
Deliver a short text message to a person's phone.

Parameters
----------
recipient : str
    Phone number in E.164 form such as +14155550123.
text : str
    Message body, at most 160 characters.

Returns
-------
str
    Delivery id.

name: post_message
description:
Post a message to a team chat space.

Parameters
----------
recipient : str
    Channel name beginning with '#', such as #ops.
text : str
    Message body.

Returns
-------
str
    Message permalink.

name: upload_file
description:
Copy a local file to cloud object storage.

Parameters
----------
path : str
    Local path of the file.
bucket : str
    Name of the S3 bucket to copy into.

Returns
-------
str
    Object URL.

name: attach_file
description:
Attach a file to a support ticket.

Parameters
----------
path : str
    Local path of the file.
ticket_id : str
    Ticket key such as SUP-1042.

Returns
-------
str
    Attachment id.

name: share_file
description:
Create a shareable download link for a file.

Parameters
----------
path : str
    Local path of the file.
expires_hours : int, optional
    Hours until the link stops working.

Returns
-------
str
    The link.

name: create_event
description:
Add an entry to the shared calendar.

Parameters
----------
title : str
    Event title shown to attendees.
start : str
    ISO-8601 start time.
attendees : list[str], optional
    Email addresses to invite.

Returns
-------
str
    Event id.

name: set_reminder
description:
Schedule a personal notification.

Parameters
----------
text : str
    What to remind about.
at : str
    ISO-8601 time at which the notification fires.

Returns
-------
str
    Reminder id.

name: block_focus_time
description:
Reserve uninterrupted time on your own schedule.

Parameters
----------
start : str
    ISO-8601 start time.
duration_minutes : int
    Length of the block in minutes.
mute_notifications : bool, optional
    Silence all notifications during the block.

Returns
-------
str
    Block id.

name: convert_currency
description:
Convert an amount between currencies.

Parameters
----------
amount : float
    Amount to convert.
source : str
    ISO 4217 code of the source, such as EUR.
target : str
    ISO 4217 code of the target, such as JPY.

Returns
-------
float
    Converted amount.

name: convert_units
description:
Convert a measurement between units.

Parameters
----------
amount : float
    Value to convert.
source : str
    Unit symbol of the source, such as km, lb or degF.
target : str
    Unit symbol of the target.

Returns
-------
float
    Converted value.

name: convert_timezone
description:
Convert a clock time between time zones.

Parameters
----------
amount : str
    Clock time to convert, such as 14:30.
source : str
    IANA zone name of the source, such as Europe/Paris.
target : str
    IANA zone name of the target.

Returns
-------
str
    Converted clock time.
